g.text: Expanded chose update-enabled mode in 0/6 training fits; its OOF outcomes coincide with Priced.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: Annual uses the strict Balanced target; Pending holds after crossing. Equal thirds uses a different target.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: Priced selects a fixed-target controller; Expanded selects fixed/update controllers, using training paths only.

g.text: Quantiles describe path dispersion, not confidence intervals. Fees are nominal amounts, not return points.
